verdict.rationale: Marqeta docs show virtual card issuance, merchant-restricted authorization controls, velocity/spending caps, and JIT funding where the issuer approves/denies exact amounts per transaction — together these let a developer construct a one-purchase, one-merchant, exact-amount card. However, there's no explicit 'single-use card' or auto-expire-after-one-transaction feature documented, requiring the developer to assemble these primitives themselves. Missing for 10: explicit single-use/one-time-card issuance endpoint, independent/hands-on confirmation of exact-amount enforcement in production.
